text: ＊って　かっこいいよな　あの　はなしかたが　たまんねー！

structure.jp: あの　はなしかたが

structure.en: I can't get enough of it!

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a name is a casual way to bring up who you are about to talk about, like a chatty は. ＊って = '＊, well, they...'

patterns.name: 〜よな
patterns.explanation: よな at the end is a casual, mostly male way to say something with feeling and expect the listener to agree. かっこいいよな = 'so cool, right?'

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた after the stem of a verb means 'the way of doing' it. はなしかた = 'way of talking'
